verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine ships multiple documented public APIs suitable for programmatic/agentic control: a Python scripting API for editor automation (unreal-docs-4, unreal-docs-28, unreal-docs-29), a REST-like Remote Control API served over HTTP/WebSocket for driving the engine remotely (unreal-docs-22, unreal-docs-23, unreal-docs-24, unreal-docs-25, unreal-docs-34), plus C++ and command-line interfaces (unreal-docs-2, unreal-docs-7, unreal-probe-1). These are official, well-documented, and designed for external/automated control rather than just manual use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of an AI agent actually driving Unreal via these APIs, and no mention of a dedicated MCP or agent-facing wrapper.
